title.zh: 对第 9727 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Section 1 of Republic Act No. 9727, Reapportioning the Province of Cavite Into Eight (8) Legislative Districts
title.orig: An Act Amending Section 1 of Republic Act No. 9727, Reapportioning the Province of Cavite Into Eight (8) Legislative Districts

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11069_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 9727 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Legislative Districts. — The Province of Cavite, which shall have eight (8) legislative districts to commence on the next national and local elections after the effectivity of this Act, is hereby reapportioned as follows:
FIRST LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Cavite City
(2) Kawit
(3) Noveleta
(4) Rosario SECOND LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Bacoor City THIRD LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Imus City FOURTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Dasmariñas City FIFTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Carmona
(2) General Mariano Alvarez (GMA)
(3) Silang SIXTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) General Trias City SEVENTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Trece Martires City
(2) Indang
(3) Tanza
(4) Amadeo EIGHTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Tagaytay City
(2) Alfonso
(3) General Aguinaldo
(4) Magallanes
(5) Maragondon
(6) Mendez
(7) Naic
(8) Ternate."

Incumbent Representatives. – The incumbent Representatives of the Sixth and Seventh Legislative Districts of the Province of Cavite shall continue to represent their respective legislative districts until the new Representative shall have been elected and qualified.
Rules and Regulations. – The Commission on Elections shall issue the necessary rules and regulations within thirty (30) days upon the approval of this Act.
Repealing Clause. – Republic Act No. 9727 and all other laws, rules and regulations which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
